title.en: An Act Converting the Rural Health Unit in Novaliches, Second District of Quezon City, Into A Five-bed Capacity Health Infirmary, To Be Known As the Novaliches Health Infirmary, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The rural health unit in Novaliches, Second District of Quezon City, is hereby converted into a five-bed capacity health infirmary, to be known as the Novaliches Health lnfirmary.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
